hero.subtitle: Celebration on a shared flight | Approximately 40 minutes | Breakfast included

description.title: Celebrate Your Story Above the Clouds
description.paragraph: Celebrate your story with a shared flight over the Teotihuacán Valley, a Happy Anniversary banner, a traditional toast, and full breakfast. If you prefer greater intimacy, you can upgrade the experience to a private flight.

steps.title: 5:00 AM - Arrive & Check-in
steps.description: You’ll arrive at Flying Pictures Reception, where our team will welcome you and help you complete check-in.

steps.title: Welcome & Coffee Break
steps.description: After you complete your check-in we will welcome you with our coffee station with hot beverages and traditional cookies.

steps.title: The Inflation Spectacle
steps.description: Walk to the launch field to watch the "Giants" come to life. Seeing the massive balloons rise with the roar of the burners is the first act of the show.

steps.title: The Ascent
steps.description: Lift off gently into the dawn. For approx. 45-60 minutes, float silently over the Valley of Teotihuacán, watching the sun reveal the pyramids from above.

steps.title: The 1783 Toast
steps.description: Upon landing, we celebrate with a traditional sparkling wine toast. A ritual dating back to the first aviators to thank the wind gods for a safe return.

included: Coffee break with cookies and traditional Mexican drinks
Sparkling-wine toast or a non-alcoholic option
notIncluded: Transport between Mexico City and Teotihuacán
Admission or guide for the archaeological zone
French champagne — the included toast uses sparkling wine
recommendedExtras: Shared round-trip transport from $500 MXN per person

The route and flight time depend on the day's weather and operating conditions.

steps.title: Arrive together at the Globoport
steps.description: Enjoy coffee and traditional drinks while the team prepares the balloon.

steps.title: See your banner displayed
steps.description: The Happy Anniversary banner becomes part of the celebration before the flight.

steps.title: Begin the ascent
steps.description: The pilot begins the flight when conditions are suitable.

steps.title: Fly for approximately 40 minutes
steps.description: Share views of the Teotihuacán Valley from a Cameron basket.

steps.title: Toast to your story
steps.description: Celebrate with sparkling wine or a non-alcoholic option.

steps.title: Have breakfast and receive your certificate
steps.description: Finish with a full breakfast and a personalised certificate of the experience.
